made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/plaza-sheet-make.js, from plaza-set.html (window.PLAZA.E) and the design of La plaza (the orchestrator's p6-spec, section plaza). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 118. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), z up; the set's PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 118 + 13 v - 22.5 z (a wall that faces the camera is a plane v = const). The seat is at v 0 (u from -1.4 to 2.6), the board at v -1.3, the cart at (3.05, 3.5)
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the paving; z .46: the seat's top; z 1.17: the top of its back; z 1: the board's ledge; z 1.02: the cart's top) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up, 41 for a child; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, 24 rows drawn (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); a grown-up sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1: Ana's abuela at asiento1): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 11: 41) on (sx, sy), 41 rows drawn above it; Canelo lying mkPerro('lie') (30 x 22): column 15 and its bottom edge; a pigeon (stand-in: the El parque bird, 29 x 22): its bottom middle on the point; a small thing (the cards, a photo hung by its top middle: its top row on the hook's row): a stand-in on the point
rules.view: a view has a zoom (here 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture) and x0 = the window's left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.bubbles: the two answer bubbles (burbuja_a at the left, burbuja_b at the right; the act says which line each carries): two 22 x 22 px squares, 4 px apart, together centred on the frog's middle column, their foot (the bottom edge) 3 px above the top row of his head: bottom edge = (his top ink row) - 3; so for a frog at a spot (sx, sy) with his top ink row sy - 24: a = [sx - 24, sy - 49, 22, 22] (columns sx - 24 to sx - 3), b = [sx + 2, sy - 49, 22, 22]. The boxes in things are those of the frog at asiento2

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the cart's awning, its posts and its body, the seat, the board and its roof hide whoever is behind them.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where the set's baked depth (window.DEPTH.z of the set page) is more than depth(r) + bias. The same rule as El cruce's sheet: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn. The two bubbles are drawn last, over everything

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the ground (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28, the dog .3: open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits on the seat, stands on the ledge or on the cart's top (z above 0) casts none: that is not ground (a shadow cast at the pavement under it would show in front of it). The pigeons cast none
